stories.title: Yemeni forces claim killing of eight Houthi fighters
stories.summary: Yemeni forces claim killing of eight Houthi fighters  Yemeni government forces said they repelled an attack by Houthi fighters in the south western province of Taiz, saying they killed at least eight.  The  military command said that clashes erupted in al-Safa, and it involved heavy exchanges of fire.

stories.title: Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch site in Louisiana
stories.summary: Multi-billionaire Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX has announced that it will build its largest launch site yet in the southern US state of Louisiana. Construction of the $100bn (£73bn) project - named Starbase - is due to start next year, with the 125,000-acre (50,585-hectare) site expanding on the company's operations beyond its current Texas headquarters and locations in Florida. It will be used to "support thousands of Starship flights a year with missions launching to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond," SpaceX said on Tuesday. In June, SpaceX shares started trading on New York's technology-focused Nasdaq in the world's biggest ever stock market debut. SpaceX said it aims to launch its first Starship flight from the new base in 2029. The Louisiana facility will add more than 3,000 jobs to the region, the company said. The Louisiana Economic Development agency said the average wage of workers at the base would be 192% more than the region's current mean salary.
